description: Fix Vulkan-Hpp handle usage on 32-bit targets. ( #22892 ) On 32-bit platforms, Vulkan non-dispatchable handles such as VkBuffer are represented as uint64_t, and Vulkan-Hpp disables implicit conversions for type safety.
